text.tspan: PMDS prototype radio, step 3, sheet 2: the amplifiers, from the sampling capacitors to the Audio Adaptor
Each buffer: x11 at 12 kHz, x1 at DC, so every output sits at the 2.5 V bias. U3, U4, U5: MCP6022, pin 8 to +5VA, pin 4 to GND, 100 nF across.
A station above the oscillator comes out at +12 kHz.
If the decoder never finds it, swap the two line-input wires.
+5VA feeds U1 to U5 and R3
